summary: This change fixes the astro-check TTY hang by forcing non-interactive execution via CI env vars, a closed stdin, and a project-local binary preference over global package runners.

pr_summary.headline: This change fixes the astro-check TTY hang by forcing non-interactive execution via CI env vars, a closed stdin, and a project-local binary preference over global package runners.

walkthrough.text: base.py and subprocess_executor.py thread an optional stdin: int | None = None parameter through the three-layer subprocess call chain (_run_subprocess -> _run_subprocess_result -> run_subprocess -> subprocess.run), defaulting to None so no existing caller is affected.

astro_check.py introduces _local_astro_binary() to return node_modules/.bin/astro on POSIX or astro.cmd on Windows, and _get_astro_command/_build_command gain an optional cwd param to consult it before falling back to shutil.which.

check() assembles run_env from get_subprocess_env() and injects CI=1 and ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1, then calls _run_subprocess with stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL; the except block is extended with a timeout warning logging cwd and cmd.

test_non_interactive.py adds eight regression tests covering CI env injection, POSIX/Windows local binary selection, directory-shim discrimination, global fallback, and timeout-to-ToolResult handling — all mocked at _run_subprocess.

verdict_reasoning.deciding_factor: Nothing blocks the merge. The fix is correct end-to-end: get_subprocess_env() returns a copy of os.environ, so CI=1 and ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 survive; run_subprocess merges with {**os.environ, **env} so the injected keys take precedence; stdin=stdin is present at subprocess_executor.py:228; and PermissionError from a non-executable local shim is caught by the OSError handler at astro_check.py:417.

file_assessments.overview: Adds an optional stdin: int | None = None parameter to _run_subprocess_result and _run_subprocess, passing it positionally to run_subprocess.
Adds stdin: int | None = None to run_subprocess's signature and passes it as stdin=stdin to subprocess.run.

Introduces _local_astro_binary() for project-local binary discovery, extends _get_astro_command and _build_command with an optional cwd param, and forces non-interactive execution in check() via CI env vars and stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL.

New test file with eight regression tests for the non-interactive execution fix, covering CI env injection, local binary preference (POSIX and Windows), directory-shim discrimination, global fallback, and timeout handling — all mocked at _run_subprocess.

findings.title: stdin=stdin not covered by any test
findings.description: The new tests all mock _run_subprocess, so the critical one-liner stdin=stdin at subprocess_executor.py:228 (and the positional threading through base.py:406 and base.py:439) is never exercised. If that line were absent or the positional argument order were swapped, every test in test_non_interactive.py would still pass — the captured['stdin'] assertion verifies only that check() assembles the right args, not that those args reach subprocess.run. The existing test_subprocess.py and test_subprocess_result.py suites also make no assertions about stdin.
findings.cause: Tests intercept at _run_subprocess (an instance boundary above the subprocess_executor layer). The downstream chain _run_subprocess -> _run_subprocess_result -> run_subprocess -> subprocess.run(stdin=stdin) runs outside any test's observation.
findings.fix: Add a test to tests/unit/plugins/base/test_subprocess_result.py that calls run_subprocess directly with stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL and a command that would block reading stdin (e.g. `cat` or `read`), asserting it exits immediately rather than hanging — confirming stdin is wired through to the OS call.
